summary: All seven round-2 camera issues are fixed and re-verified in the live game. The crash cam no longer enters vehicles: 0 eye-in-box frames across 7 forced traffic crashes and 4 autopilot laps with traffic + police on coast, mountain and city. Respawns cut under the blink, the SHOWTIME exit lands settled, pause freezes the camera, and the cruise framing meets the 24 % floor (lap p5 178-180 px of 720). Follow smoothness is frame-rate independent: sub-pixel residuals at 30/60/144 fps and with uneven pacing. Blends are smooth bells. Curves, jumps, look-back, hit-stop, wall/tunnel clearance and boost FOV with counter-dolly all read at commercial quality. No blocker or major issue remains. Five minors remain: (1) a rival drafting in the 5 m camera gap fully hides the hero for up to 0.8 s (city lap: 3 full-hide episodes, the last in the middle of a fight); (2) chase distance is measured along the centre line, so tight bends zoom the hero 181-278 px depending on the racing line, and the coast hairpin drift exit shrinks it by a third during the boost; (3) KO exits just under the 90 deg cut threshold whip ~85 deg in 0.35 s (7.4 deg/frame at 60 fps, ~15 at 30 fps); (4) the water crash shot is a horizon-less telephoto view of empty sea; (5) the unit's own camera telemetry is red (ultHandback). Evidence: shots/review/sim/r3-camera/.

r2_followup.1 major crash cam inside vehicles: FIXED. t7-traffic.mjs seeds 3/5 (parked car, oncoming car x2, stopped van, moving van, oncoming van): 0 eye-in-box frames. Car vaults pass 0.7-0.9 m over the roof; vans throw the body back toward the camera side (sheet-crash.jpg rows 1-3). Autopilot laps coast s7/s3, mountain s4 and city s4 report inObs 0 (t30-lap-*.json). Telemetry trafficCam passes 9/9.
r2_followup.2 minor respawn glide loses the rider: FIXED. The respawn now cuts under the blink: t4 traffic cuts 31 deg and water cuts 71 deg in one frame, with 0 off-screen frames. Laps report blendOff 0, and telemetry respawnCam shows onScreen 1.0.
r2_followup.3 minor SHOWTIME exit unsettled: FIXED. The fx ult shot now ends 7.5 deg off the chase pose. The 0.33 s blend goes from 2.58 m to a settled 2.15-2.18 m (rest 2.18) at <= 0.7 deg/frame (t5u.log).
r2_followup.4 minor pause does not freeze: FIXED. Over 1 s of pause, buzz, crash shake and boost kick all give 0 deg rotation, 0 m movement and constant FOV (t8.log).
r2_followup.5 minor water crash speck: PARTLY. FOV narrowing keeps the pelican readable at ~110-150 px instead of 20-30 px, but the shot became a top-down view of empty sea (issue 4).
r2_followup.6 minor telemetry blind spots: FIXED in coverage (trafficCam, respawnCam, ultHandback, pauseCam added), but ultHandback now fails on correct behaviour (issue 5).
r2_followup.7 minor hero framing: FIXED. SPEC now uses 4.3->5.1 m and FOV 60->70. Lap hero size is p5 178-180 px and p50 186 px (24.7 / 25.8 % of 720). The actor box measures 191-203 px on a straight (t23).

issues.title: A rival drafting in the camera gap fully hides the hero for up to 0.8 s, including mid-fight (src/camera/avoid.ts only tests session.obstacles, never riders)
issues.detail: Riders are 1.8-1.9 m tall, which is close to the 2.2 m eye height. A rival riding 1-4 m behind the player on the same line therefore covers the whole pelican. I cast rays (track space, t30-lap.mjs) from the eye to 9 points on the hero (wheels, hips, chest and head at three s offsets) against rival boxes. City s4 autopilot lap: >= 5/9 rays blocked for 134 frames in 7 episodes, fully hidden (9/9) at frames 2939-2961, 3335-3357 and 4136-4185 (0.83 s, ending in the player's KO of rival 2). Coast s3: 14 frames at 6/9. Mountain s4: 3 frames. sheet-occl.jpg rows 1-3 (city 48.9-49.3 s and 68.9-69.7 s): only the drafting goose is visible and the pelican is behind it. Slipstream makes AI riders sit in exactly this spot, and fights happen there too, so the player loses sight of their own swing and skill animations when they matter most (pillars 1 and 2).
issues.fix: In avoid.ts, add racing non-player riders as boxes (|ds| < 0.85, |dx| < 0.35, y < 1.9) to the sight-line test against the hero's chest and head points (not the 0.8 m mid point only). While blocked, lift the eye 0.6-0.9 m on the same omega-12 spring, or push it 0.6 m sideways toward the open side, and keep looking at the hero. Optionally file a core request so actors dither or fade riders within ~2.5 m of the camera. Telemetry: on a city autopilot lap, at least 5/9 hero points must be visible in >= 98 % of racing frames, and no fully hidden run may exceed 6 frames.

issues.title: Chase distance is centre-line arc length, so tight bends zoom the hero in or out with the racing line and drift-exit boosts shrink it by a third (src/camera/chase.ts:153 camS = followS - dist*cos(hy))
issues.detail: Physics advances s with the curve metric 1/clamp(1 - kappa*x) (src/sim/physics.ts:61), but the chase cam subtracts a plain dist from s. On the inside of a bend the eye is closer than spec, and on the outside it is farther. Mountain R27 switchback at a constant 12 m/s (t34-mountain.json, sheet-tight.jpg): inside line (x +5.5) eye 4.01 m and hero 269 px; outside line (x -5.5) 5.92 m and 181 px; the straight just before gives 5.0 m and 212 px. That is a 1.5x size difference for the same speed and corner. R26 drift: 188 -> 278 px, then back to 190 px within 0.5 s at the exit. Coast L46 hairpin drift (t32-corners.json, sheet-corners.jpg row 3-4): 186 -> 254 px against the inside rail. After the L3 release, with the 12 deg boost kick running, it drops to 170 px (23.6 % of 720) within 0.75 s. SPEC 6 says the boost must never shrink the rider and requires >= 24 %. Mountain and city have R26-R35 switchbacks on every lap, and drifting through them is the intended line.
issues.fix: Place the eye at the world distance: camS = followS - dist*cos(hy) / clamp(1 - kappa(camS)*camX, 0.7, 1.3), with one fixed-point iteration (re-sample kappa at the new camS). Do the same for the look-ahead (followS + ahead / metric at lx). Telemetry: on the mountain R27 inside and outside lines and the R26 drift, dRider must stay within +-8 % of the straight-line value at the same speed, and the hero must not shrink more than 5 % during a drift-release boost.

issues.title: KO exits just under the 90 deg cut threshold whip ~85 deg in 0.35 s: 7.4 deg/frame at 60 fps and ~15 deg/frame at 30 fps, swinging low past the victim with a dutch roll (src/camera/blend.ts BLEND.cutAngle 90 deg, maxTurn 480 deg/s)
issues.detail: Gaps over 90 deg cut cleanly on the fx flash (lap cuts of 122-150 deg). A gap just under 90 deg instead runs the full 0.35 s blend. Coast s7 lap, frames 9763-9773: 4.4, 5.4, 6.2, 6.8, 7.3, 7.4, 7.2, 6.9, 6.2, 5.4, 4.4 deg/frame (t30-lap-coast-s7.json). In sheet-lap-b.jpg row 4 (162.67-162.97 s) the camera sweeps from the low KO angle, past the tumbling victim with a bike wheel filling the corner and a tilted horizon, then into the chase. City s4 frames 4270-4278 peak at 6.4 deg/frame. Synthetic az85 peaks at 456.8 deg/s (t3.log), which is 15.2 deg/frame at 30 fps; az60 at 30 fps already measures 10.7 deg/frame. About one KO exit in four in the laps takes this path. Without motion blur, a whip at this rate strobes, especially on the city's neon. It is not a pop and it is within spec, but it is clearly rougher than the cut exits.
issues.fix: Lower BLEND.cutAngle to ~55-60 deg, or cut whenever the required peak rate PEAK*ang/dur exceeds ~300 deg/s. The fx whoosh and post-FX fade already mask a cut, as they do for the >90 deg exits. Keep blends for small residuals (intro, SHOWTIME 7.5 deg, synthetic 30 deg). Telemetry: the KO hand-back must cut or stay <= 5 deg/frame at 60 fps and <= 10 deg/frame at 30 fps.

issues.title: Water crash shot: ~2 s of horizon-less telephoto sea (src/camera/chase.ts crashZoom + crashRise)
issues.detail: The round-2 fix keeps the floating pelican readable, but the clamped eye now looks 15.5 deg down with the FOV narrowed to 30.8-34 deg. The horizon sits at or above the top edge, so from 1.3 s to 3.0 s after the splash the frame is flat turquoise with the bird in it: no beach, no horizon, and nothing to show where it came from (sheet-crash.jpg row 4, t4-water.csv: horizon out of frame in 39 of 157 crashed frames, and only borderline in the rest). Pelican Bay's sea is the coast track's signature hazard, so this shot repeats often.
issues.fix: Limit the crash-cam pitch so the horizon stays in the top quarter (pitch >= -(fov/2 - 6 deg)). Raise the zoom floor to ~40 deg and let the extra size come from crashRise instead. Bias the 12 deg/s orbit so the shore and road are in the background. Alternatively, let only the crash cam drift up to ~3 m past a water/void edge, where nothing solid exists.

issues.title: Unit telemetry is red: ultHandback.handbackDy 0.396 > 0.3 (tools/feel-scenarios-cam2.mjs ultHandback)
issues.detail: I ran node tools/feel-telemetry.mjs --only jitter,camera,handoff,trafficCam,respawnCam,ultHandback,pauseCam: 44/45 checks pass (shots/review/sim/r3-camera/tele/metrics.json), against the 106/106 claimed in status/sim.md. The fx SHOWTIME shot now ends 7.5 deg from the chase pose, so the rig correctly blends instead of cutting. The check reads the eye height on the first non-cinematic frame, which is the blend start at the cinematic's 2.58 m. The camera itself settles to 2.15-2.18 m in 0.33 s (t5u.log). The check therefore fails on correct behaviour, and it would pass a hand-back that cuts onto a bad pose after one frame.
issues.fix: Measure what the player sees: rig.chasePose() height on the first frame after the override ends must be within 0.3 m of rest, and the rendered eye must converge to rest +-0.1 m by the end of the blend with <= 2 deg/frame. Re-run the full feel-telemetry after each cross-unit change and keep status/sim.md honest about the pass count.

verified_ok: Frame-rate independence (t1.log): slalom, S-bend and drift at dt 1/30, 1/60, 1/144 and uneven pacing. Bike screen residual <= 0.83 px sx and <= 0.97 px sy; roll, pitch and yaw residual <= 0.12 deg; FOV <= 0.0006 deg outside the drift-boost onset. Cross-rate framing is within 0.3-7 px; the largest offsets are drift-event timing.

Blends (t3.log): smootherstep bells at 30/60/85 deg peaking at 2.76/5.42/7.61 deg/frame, with the same 325 deg/s at 30/60/144 fps. The camera stays >= 4.5 m from the rider. Intro -> GO peaks at 0.27 deg/frame (t5.log).

KO / WRECKED hand-backs (t2-ko.log, t2-wrecked.log): 123 / 108 deg cuts on the fx flash. After the KO cut, the fx whoosh kick (+7 deg) is counter-dollied and the rider holds sx 655-665 at the same size. The wrecked exit cuts to a crash cam 3.4-3.9 m from the body.
Crash cams (sheet-crash.jpg): traffic crash bodies stay centred 4.3-5.5 m away with a slow orbit; the car vault reads as a stunt shot over the roof; van bounce-backs stay on the camera side.

Laps with traffic + police + 4 rivals (t30-lap-*.json; coast s7/s3, mountain s4, city s4, ~10.5k frames each): 0 eye-in-box frames, 0 off-screen blend frames, rotation p50 0.06-0.08 and p99 0.48-0.72 deg/frame, and no spikes outside KO blends. Chase clearance is >= 1.6 m; the 1.15-1.35 m minimum is only the fx KO-cam pose at blend start. No page errors.

Corners (t32-corners.json, sheet-corners.jpg): the coast chicane L60/R60 and the L46 hairpin at 20 m/s keep the rider within +-65 px of centre, with the road 25/40 m ahead always on screen. Roll is lean x 0.18 (+-6.9 deg at 38 deg lean) at <= 0.42 deg/frame. In a drift, the view yaws 15-17 deg into the slide, giving a readable 3/4 angle.
Jumps (t9.log): crest (0.82 s air) and ramp (0.63/0.72 s) keep the head >= 246 px at <= 0.36 deg/frame, with a landing dip and PERFECT kick.

Shake and hit-stop (t10.log): hit / heavy / crash / landing peak at 0.34 / 1.13 / 1.25 / 0.25 deg. During hit-stop the camera moves 0 m and the FOV punches in -3 deg. Pause freezes everything (t8.log).

Clearance (t12.log): cliff rock, rail, cutting, both tunnel walls and the bridge parapet; the eye stays 0.65-1.0 m inside the walls at 2.13-2.19 m above the road. Overtaking and cutting in front of trucks and buses, and squeezing past them, never triggers the obstacle lift (t35-cutin.json: lift 0, <= 0.33 deg/frame).
Speed sensation (sheet-speed.jpg): FOV 70 at 20 m/s gives a classic chase composition (horizon at ~43 %). An L3 release widens to FOV 82 with speed lines, while the counter-dolly holds the hero size.
Look-back (t13.log): clean cuts, and the drafter behind is readable. Menu orbit runs at FOV 50.
Typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json reports 0 errors in src/camera and src/sim (the 3 remaining errors are in fx files).
